title: CMW project identity and ID-owner configuration v1 (Phase 0 proposal)
description: Proposed .cmw-project.json identity record. owner_node_id is the enrolled persistent node UUID, never an SSH/display alias. legacy_nodes binds historical node tokens; legacy_queues binds queue tokens to existing enrolled or unenrolled source-state evidence. Mapping stability, object identity and uniqueness require semantic checks.

legacy_nodes.description: Stable historical node token to persistent node UUID. Empty is allowed for projects without legacy references. Tokens must never be rebound; duplicate values and ambiguous historical queue IDs are rejected by future semantic validation.

legacy_queues.description: Materialized initial node/queue token bindings from the project integrity journal. Empty is allowed when no legacy queues are mapped. Record each initial source binding once; later path moves do not change references. Semantic validation must require mapped nodes, unique source queues, immutable bindings and unambiguous short references; schemas establish syntax only.

queue_id.description: Existing enrolled queue UUID when recorded; null for an unenrolled source queue. Never mint a UUID to fill a historical unknown.

state_root.description: Initial absolute owner-local state directory locator recorded once in the project integrity journal. It is source evidence, not queue identity; later moves do not change job references.

root_identity.description: Original filesystem [device, inode] evidence retained in the initial project integrity-journal binding for this node and source object.

database_identity.description: Original filesystem [device, inode] evidence retained in the initial project integrity-journal binding for this node and source object.
